verdict.rationale: Cua documents named agents with "routines the daemon fires," plus notifications and pause/resume, which points to non-interactive, daemon-driven scheduled execution. This rests on a single brief line, though. Nothing documents triggering a task from an external event such as a webhook or inbound event hook. The SDK and CLI are only building blocks a developer could wire up and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: detailed scheduling docs (cron/interval semantics, configuration), documented external event or webhook triggers, hands-on corroboration that routines run unattended.
